domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n greater than 1
the expression E_n(x+m) is defined for the given n and input x+m
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n with n greater than 1, for all real numbers x, and for all integers m, the value of E_n at input x plus m equals the value of E_n at input x.
quantifier_order: for all n in integers with n greater than 1
for all x in real numbers

variables.name: x
variables.role: input variable to the function E_n

witness_dependencies: none (the equality must hold uniformly for all n, x, and m)

statement_nl: For every integer n>1, every real number x, and every integer m, one has E_n(x + m) = E_n(x).
